test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Read between the lines.

options.text: Be afraid of doing something again
Speak the truth even if it is unpleasant
Understand something that is not said outright

solution: The correct answer is **'Understand something that is not said outright'.**
